title: EventEnvelope
description: Shared envelope for all Cortexa Service Bus events. Every event published to any topic must conform to this schema. The payload property is event-specific and validated separately per event type.

event_type.description: Dot-separated event type identifier, e.g. 'ingestion.completed'. Matches the Service Bus topic name.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this message instance. Used for deduplication and idempotency checks.

schema_version.description: Monotonic version of this envelope schema. Starts at 1. Additive-only changes increment this value; breaking changes require a new topic.

batch_id.description: Identifier of the orchestration batch this event belongs to.

document_id.description: Identifier of the document within the batch. Optional — not all events are document-scoped (e.g. engine.completed covers a full batch run).

correlation_id.description: Tracing identifier propagated from the originating HTTP request X-Correlation-Id header. Must be preserved unchanged through the entire pipeline.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the event occurred on the publishing service. Must include timezone offset (Z or +00:00).

payload.description: Event-specific data. Schema is defined per event type in event-types.md. This object must not be empty.
